title: incident-bot: integrate SLO toolkit runbook links into oncall diagnostics
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: on-call engineers need quicker access to authoritative runbooks when an SLO violation is detected. This PR augments the incident-bot oncall diagnostics flow to surface SLO toolkit runbook links and adds ranking metadata so runbooks are suggested in priority order.

Summary: Add integration with slo-toolkit runbook metadata for SLO-linked runbooks, cache runbook lookup results to reduce latency, expose runbook links and rationale in the oncall summary card, and add end-to-end tests + docs. Key behaviors: 1) when an SLO alert is processed the bot fetches runbooks associated with the SLO and ranks them by severity/context match; 2) runbook links are shown in the oncall diagnostics card with quick actions (open, copy link); 3) results are cached per-SLO for 10 minutes to avoid added tail latency; 4) instrumentation added for runbook fetch latency and cache hit/miss.

Checklist: [x] fetch runbook metadata from slo-toolkit API [x] ranking heuristics based on tags and context overlap [x] cache layer with ttl and metrics [x] unit tests for ranking and cache [x] e2e test for slack card rendering [x] update docs (oncall runbooks guide) [x] changelog/release notes prepared

Testing: unit tests added under tests/unit/test_runbook_ranking.py and tests/unit/test_runbook_cache.py. E2E Slack rendering test added under tests/e2e/test_oncall_card_render.py (uses fixture slack-mock). CI initially failed lint due to unused import; fixed in follow-up commit. Local perf tests show ~70ms median overhead for runbook lookups with cache warm (cache miss ~210ms).

Deployment notes: safe to roll out; feature gated behind runtime flag INCIDENT_BOT_ENABLE_SLO_RUNBOOKS (default on for canary). No database migrations. Canary to 5% teams for 24h, then full rollout.

Related: Linear ENG-4721 (runbook surfaced in oncall), ENG-4802 (slo-toolkit runbook metadata API). References: internal doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4721 and design: docs/oncall/runbooks.md.
